name: gravoth-web
description: Gravoth Online: the API (apps/server), the website (apps/web) and the contracts both import (packages/contracts). A Bun monorepo on dunx.

scripts.check: bun run lint:check && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.test: bun run test:contracts && bun run test:web && bun run test:server
